question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Detriment
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Detriment"** means something that causes damage, harm, or loss. (हानि)

 
 
• **Example: **Smoking is a **detriment **to your health.
 
 
 
• **"Advantage" **refers to a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable or superior position. (लाभ)
 
 
• **Example: **Having a good education is an** advantage** in finding a job.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'detriment' **is **'advantage'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dilemma **(दुविधा): A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially ones that are equally undesirable.

 
 
• **Example:** She faced a dilemma about whether to accept the new job offer or stay with her current employer.
 
 
 
• **Corner **(कोना ): The point or area where two sides or edges meet.
 
 
• **Example: **The cat hid in the corner of the room.
 
 
 
• **Difficulty** (कठिनाई): The state or condition of being hard to do, deal with, or understand.
 
 
• **Example:** He had difficulty understanding the complex instructions.
